description.en: Fully restores the GP and the TP of every member of the party list, despite its name: each member's GP and TP are set to their maximum. Unlike the IS_MAX checks, it is not limited to 16 members. The events call it together with CMND_TEAM_TP_RECV_ALL, which does nothing.

true once done.
null if the script system is not ready or the player data is not available.

examples.case: After a dialogue, before the objective update (real usage, from ev42061300.nut)
